notes.title: NEW GIRLS!!! Queen, Sorceress, Shaman...
notes.content:
Hello everyone!!!

JOY RESORT center where nurses and modern technology take care of the health of visitors through SEXUAL treatments. 

You are a patient of this unique resort.
We've added a brand new Fantasy location.
You will get to the town on the back of a flying dragon.
You will be able to have fun with the queen of these regions, a sexy sorceress and a shaman in a cave.

We're received a lot of feedback from you since Cyber Sex Horny Nurses release.
Some of it was about game's features and some was strictly about technical stuff. 
We have been working very hard to fix the bugs and add new content.

As for the technical ones, we fixed:

- Support for WMR controllers (fixed)
- Several people reported that the trigger to enter the location is not working (fixed)
- We've added the ability to play without VR (but we highly don't recommend it, it's currently in testing)

We checked and tested the game on many VR devices.
However, we are not able to have all of them.
In case of problems, please write.

Have fun :-)

notes.title: About UPDATE
notes.content:
Thanks for visiting JOY RESORT. 

We're starting the holiday break, but some people from our team are already working on the first update of CYBER SEX HORNY NURSES.
Thank you very much for your feedback, both positive and negative. We read them very carefully and will implement them in the upcoming updates.
We plan to add new content every month, we want to increase the number of attractions at JOY RESORT and add new simulations and new mechanics.
In the first update, we plan to add FANTASY SIMULATIONS where you will have fun with girls known from the fantasy world.

Thank you again

JOY RESORT TEAM
